title: Black hole Firewalls - with Sean Carroll and Jennifer Ouellette
summary: A Royal Institution event with Sean Carroll and Jennifer Ouellette on what happens if you fall into a black hole, covering the firewall paradox, the information problem and the holographic principle.
why: Recommended as a high-level but clear explanation of the black hole information paradox and competing theories, by a physicist known for making quantum mechanics approachable.

quote.text: explains the paradox and several different competing theories at a high level.
